description: The developer's team for an app (Business › Team in the panel): people who sign in to developers.neblla.com with their own email and use this MCP with their own account, each in one or more groups whose rights add up. A group says, per area of the panel (home, stats, people, business, moderation, team, testers, panels, features, money, build, publish, settings), "read" or "write". "list" → { team: [{ key, email, name, groups, access, panels, role, status: active | invited | not_registered | expired | banned, expiresAt?, invitedBy? }] }; "lookup" { email } → { registered, name } (the whole address only); "friends" → { friends: [{ id, name }] } (Neblla friends of the developer, who can be invited by id); "groups" → { groups: [{ id, name, rights, own, panels, template, members }], templates } (templates: "partner", "support", "viewer", "screens", "staff"). Changes nothing; neblla_team invites, removes and edits groups.
name: neblla_team_read
title: Team (read)
